title: playwright-snap
subtitle: Website snapshots, with a maintained browser
description: Render a page with Playwright and return a PNG or PDF as base64. Moving from pyppeteer-snap takes a one-line import change.
longDescription: The maintained successor to pyppeteer-snap uses Playwright-driven Chromium to render JavaScript-heavy pages. It keeps the same function names, arguments and return types, with a Python API and command-line interface for PNG and PDF snapshots.
features: PNG and PDF snapshots returned as base64
Python functions and a command-line interface
Matching pyppeteer-snap arguments and return types
